consumer: The 'has any monster noticed the avatar' flag's reader, asking the yes/no question: does this monster currently see/perceive the avatar, evaluated per nearby monster as seer toward the avatar as target.
scope: Each nearby monster's own engine-computed sight/awareness evaluation toward the avatar (the monster as seer); not the avatar's view of monsters and not raw monster positions.
decisive_source: src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees — its body computes a boolean from range, dimension, light, line-of-sight (here.sees), night-invisibility, hide-place and crouch-coverage, i.e. whether one creature can perceive another right now.
divergence: A monster inside the export window and within raw rl_dist of the avatar but separated by an opaque wall (or in darkness, or the avatar crouched/hidden): re-deriving 'noticed' from the exported raw positions yields true, while mon.sees(avatar) returns false — exposing the wrong answer.
